name: Bilt Palladium Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR varies with the U.S. Prime Rate: Prime + 19.99% to 27.99% (Prime 6.75% as of 2026-01-14), maximum 35.99%. A 10.00% introductory APR applies to new card purchases for the first 12 billing cycles after account opening. Balance transfer APR 26.74% to 34.74%; cash advance APR 31.74% to 34.74%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee — the foreign transaction fee is listed as "None" in the Bilt Cards Rates & Fees disclosure.

credit_required.notes: Approval decisions are made by the issuing bank based on credit profile; Bilt does not publish minimum score requirements. No credit score impact to apply and see if approved.

rewards.redemption_notes: Bilt Points redeemable via 28 airline and hotel transfer partners (1:1 ratio), the Bilt Travel Portal, future rent or mortgage payments, Lyft rides, fitness classes, statement credits, eligible student loan payments, and toward a home down payment. Category rates are the headline totals published by Bilt and are inclusive of the Bilt loyalty membership and the Bilt Card multiplier earn; Bilt partner restaurant rates are "up to" and vary by restaurant. The Palladium Card pays 2X on all everyday purchases (rent and mortgage excluded) with no bonus-category selection required. Under Housing-only rewards the housing multiplier (0.5X to 1.25X) is set each billing cycle from everyday spend relative to the housing payment, with a 250-point floor.

signup_bonus.description: 50,000 Bilt Points and Bilt Gold elite status after spending $4,000 on purchases excluding rent or mortgage within the first 90 days of account opening. A further $300 in Bilt Cash is credited upon approval with no spend requirement.

benefits.title: No transaction fee on rent, mortgage and HOA
benefits.description: Earn rewards on rent, mortgage and HOA payments made through Bilt with no transaction fee. Pay via ACH (account and routing number), Venmo, PayPal, or a mailed check to bypass landlord or servicer card fees. Bilt Card 2.0 has no transaction minimum to earn on housing.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Purchases made outside the U.S. carry no foreign transaction fee; the foreign transaction fee is listed as "None" in the Bilt Cards Rates & Fees disclosure.

benefits.title: $200 annual Bilt Cash benefit
benefits.description: $200 in Bilt Cash is credited to the Bilt account upon account opening and on January 1 of each subsequent calendar year while the account is open and in good standing. It is separate from the $300 welcome bonus. Bilt Cash expires December 31 each year with up to $100 carried over.

benefits.title: $400 annual Bilt Travel Hotel credit
benefits.description: Two $200 statement credits per year (January–June and July–December) applied to qualifying hotel bookings of 2 nights or more made through the Bilt Travel Portal. Credits do not roll over between halves of the year or to the next year, and stack with Bilt Points and Bilt Cash.

benefits.title: Priority Pass lounge access
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass membership with access to 1,300+ airport lounges worldwide, for the cardholder and two guests. Authorized users on the account also receive Priority Pass access.

benefits.title: Point Accelerator
benefits.description: Redeem $200 in Bilt Cash to add 1X on everyday spending for the next $5,000 of qualifying purchases — up to 5 times per year ($25,000 of eligible purchases annually). On the Palladium Card this lifts the 2X base rate to 3X until the $5,000 is used or the year ends.

benefits.title: Bilt Neighborhood Dining bonus points
benefits.description: At Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants (20,000+ participating locations) you earn bonus Bilt Points per dollar on top of the card's 2X everyday rate, up to 5X in total on the Palladium Card. The bonus varies by restaurant and is shown in the Bilt app at the time of visit. No activation required.

benefits.title: Lyft bonus points
benefits.description: Linking Bilt and Lyft accounts earns an additional 2X Bilt Points per dollar on eligible rides; combined with the 2X everyday base rate, Palladium cardholders earn 4X total on Lyft. Uncapped.

benefits.title: Bilt Travel Portal bonus points
benefits.description: Booking through the Bilt Travel Portal earns +2X on hotels and +1X on flights in bonus Bilt Points on top of the card's base rate — 4X total on hotels and 3X total on flights.

benefits.title: 28 airline and hotel transfer partners
benefits.description: Bilt Points transfer at a 1:1 ratio to Bilt's 28 airline and hotel transfer partners, including major domestic and international airline programs and leading hotel loyalty programs.

notes: Bilt Card 2.0 premium tier, verified 2026-10-21 against bilt.com/card/palladium, the bilt.com/card comparison table, the Bilt Cards Rates & Fees disclosure and the Bilt Card Offer Terms. Issued by Column N.A., Member FDIC and serviced by Cardless, Inc.; a World Legend Mastercard. $495 annual fee with a $95 per-year authorized user fee. Pays a flat 2X on everyday purchases (rent and mortgage excluded) with no bonus-category selection, stacking to 4X on hotels and 3X on flights through the Bilt Travel Portal, 4X on Lyft and up to 5X at Bilt partner restaurants. Welcome offer is 50,000 Bilt Points plus Bilt Gold elite status after $4,000 in non-housing purchases in the first 90 days, plus $300 in Bilt Cash on approval; annual benefits add $200 in Bilt Cash, a $400 Bilt Travel Hotel credit (two $200 statement credits, 2-night minimum) and Priority Pass lounge access at 1,300+ airports. A limited edition mirror-finish card design is also offered while supplies last. APR is the Prime-based variable range published in the Rates & Fees disclosure, with a 10.00% introductory APR for the first 12 billing cycles on new card purchases.
